text: As for DMSO, it did reduce seizure activity in rats with temporal-lobe epilepsy, and we know it has several neuroprotective mechanisms, but it produced the opposite effect at some doses in an absence-epilepsy model. While a seizure continues, the rescue medicine comes first, and I'd still consider DMSO alongside it, although that's experimental.
section: Active Seizure: What Else May Help: At the Aura, and Alongside Rescue Medicine (2 of 2)
